name: Hologram
tagline: Cellular IoT connectivity platform for SIM, messaging, and device management
description: Hologram provides cellular IoT connectivity with a REST API for managing SIMs, devices, messaging, and connectivity. Developers use it to provision SIMs, send/receive data, monitor usage, and control device fleets over cellular networks.

auth.details: API key authentication for REST endpoints; self-serve signup via Hologram dashboard.

use_cases: list cellular IoT devices and SIMs
send messages to IoT devices over cellular
check SIM data usage and connectivity status
activate or pause IoT SIMs programmatically
